cue: A batch workflow uses an optional external model or capability, and missing prerequisites should be diagnosed before expensive work while preserving supported fallback output.
lesson: Trace which work depends on the requested capability and check its specific prerequisite before expensive processing. A reachable server does not prove that the selected model is installed. For one operation, use one bounded inventory request, validate the response, and match the selected model using the service's identifier and default-tag rules. Distinguish an unavailable server, a missing model, and an unreadable or malformed inventory in actionable diagnostics. Quote user-provided values safely in suggested shell commands; do not install models automatically. If the capability is optional, warn clearly and preserve independent output such as transcription and OCR; required capabilities should fail explicitly. Do not probe an unused feature. An early check cannot guarantee later availability, so retain runtime error handling with a specific fallback. Test check ordering, exact selection, changing inventory, failure diagnostics, continued output and cleanup, and paths where no check should run.
evidence: Public project albertoelopez/yt-transcribe, commit b9aa46cd227447db679d79a8613ff8234f3eb548. The original batch CLI checked only Ollama reachability after download and transcription. The fix calls ensure_ollama_model before media download, checks the selected model from one inventory snapshot, and preserves transcription/OCR when frame descriptions are unavailable. Public regressions: tests/test_cli_smoke.py::test_describe_preflight_and_outputs (10 cases failed against original source and passed with the fix), test_no_model_preflight_without_describe, and test_live_describe_rejected_without_model_preflight; tests/test_visual.py::test_model_inventory_matching, test_model_inventory_malformed, test_model_inventory_unavailable, test_model_inventory_unreadable_body, and test_ollama_available_remains_server_only. All 42 added cases passed. After applying the patch, the full unit and e2e suite reported 230 passed and 1 existing skip for ffmpeg without drawtext. These are public development regressions, not private evaluation material.
confidence: Verified for this project's optional frame-description workflow. Transfer to other tasks has not been measured. This was one implementation session, without a lesson-disabled control; no baseline-versus-evolved reliability gain is attributed to this lesson. An installed model is not proof that generation will succeed.
